items.hint: The short hand names the hour. The long hand is on the 12 or the 6.
steps: Look at the long hand. On the 12 means o'clock. On the 6 means half past.
The short hand shows the hour.
The time is {h} : {mm}.

items.q: The long hand is on the 3. Count in 5s. How many minutes past the hour is that?
items.hint: Count in 5s from the 12: one 5 for each number.
steps: Count in 5s: 5, 10, 15.
Count 3 steps of 5. You reach 15.
It is 15 minutes past the hour.

slips.say: The long hand points to the 3, but each number is 5 minutes. Count in 5s.

tpl.q: The long hand is on the {n}. Count in 5s. How many minutes past the hour is that?
tpl.hint: Count in 5s from the 12: one 5 for each number.
steps: Count in 5s up to the {n}.
Count {n} steps of 5. You reach {ans}.
It is {ans} minutes past the hour.

items.hint: One hand names the hour and the other counts the minutes.
steps: The short hand names the hour.
The long hand counts the minutes.

slips.say: The long hand counts the minutes. The short hand names the hour.

items.q: Half past 7. Write the time in digits.
items.hint: Half past means 30 minutes past the hour.
steps: Half past 7 is 7 and 30 minutes.

items.q: In a mirror a clock shows 4 o'clock. What is the real time? Type the hour.
items.hint: A mirror swaps left and right. Count the same number of steps from the 12 on the other side.
steps: In the mirror the short hand is 4 steps right of the 12.
Really it is 4 steps left of the 12, on the 8.
The real time is 8 o'clock.

slips.say: 4 is the time in the mirror. What is the real time?

tpl.q: In a mirror a clock shows {k} o'clock. What is the real time? Type the hour.
tpl.hint: A mirror swaps left and right. Count the same number of steps from the 12 on the other side.
steps: In the mirror the short hand is {k} steps from the 12 on one side.
Really it is {k} steps from the 12 on the other side.
The real time is {ans} o'clock.

items.q: In a mirror a clock shows half past 9. What is the real time? Type the hour.
items.hint: The long hand stays on the 6. Swap the short hand left and right.
steps: In the mirror the short hand is half way between the 9 and the 10.
Swap left and right: half way between the 2 and the 3.
The real time is half past 2.

slips.say: 9 is the mirror time. What is the real time?

tpl.q: In a mirror a clock shows half past {k}. What is the real time? Type the hour.
tpl.hint: The long hand stays on the 6. Swap the short hand left and right.
steps: In the mirror the short hand is half way between the {k} and the next number.
Swap left and right.
The real time is half past {ans}.

items.q: Which o'clock time looks the same in a mirror?
items.hint: Which time has both hands in a straight line, up and down?
steps: At 6 o'clock the long hand points up and the short hand points down.
A mirror swaps left and right, but up and down stay the same.
So 6 o'clock looks the same.

slips.say: At 3 o'clock the short hand points right. In a mirror it points left.

items.q: Make your own mirror clock puzzle. Choose an o'clock time. Ask a grown-up what time it is really. Many answers are right.
items.hint: Start with a real time, then swap left and right.
steps: Choose an o'clock time for the real clock.
Swap left and right to see the mirror time.
Ask a grown-up to find the real time from the mirror time.
For example, if the real clock shows 4 o'clock, the mirror shows 8 o'clock.
